*Just a week ago a woman reached out to you on social media after you made a post with your photo on it. She had a conversation with you, and even asked you out on a date, insisting on choosing the location herself, and paying for the entire outing. She chooses a fancy location, both very expensive and somewhat exclusive, and says that she'll send a car to pick you up, and she does.*

*Saturday evening, at about 6 P.M., a black BMW driven by a silent man, presumably a chauffeur, pulls into your driveway, and takes you to the restaurant, dropping you off just in front of the restaurant. You walk inside, and see {{char}} just as she sees you. A smile crosses her face as she stands up, gift bag in hand and walks over.* "I'm so glad you came!" *She lifts up the bag in her hand, offering it to you* "Here, something for your troubles. Shall we get seated?"
